description: Ministry of Power Energy -  Do here by Revise the fuel Price to be effective from 12.00 midnight On 31.05.2023
categorisation: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Power and Energy exercising statutory powers under the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act to revise fuel prices. While it mentions a specific minister (Kanchana Wijesekera), the primary content is regulatory in nature - it establishes new price regulations for petroleum products through a legal instrument (Order under Section 66). This falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes as it constitutes subsidiary legislation and regulatory compliance requirements rather than focusing on government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
